description: Run and monitor H agents, manage reusable skills, and read the environments the agents use.

h_company_new_agent_trigger.description: Runs for each new agent in H Company. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields name, description, environments, model, reasoning_effort, instructions, subagents, skills, answer_format, tools

h_company_new_environment_trigger.description: Runs for each new environment in H Company. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, kind, host, start_url, headless, session_id, mode.type, mode.width, mode.height, mode.markdown, lazy, settle_s, vault_id, browser_profile_id, use_default_browser_profile, persist_browser_profile, network.proxy_url, network.managed_proxy.country, network.managed_proxy.sticky, network.managed_proxy.pool

h_company_new_session_trigger.description: Runs for each new session in H Company. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, agent, agent_revision, status, agent_view_url, first_message.type, first_message.message, first_message.images, first_message.files, first_message.skills, first_message.caller_id, created_at, started_at, finished_at, last_activity_at, anonymized_at

h_company_new_skill_trigger.description: Runs for each new skill in H Company. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields name, description, body, source, url_pattern, compatibility, files, executable_files

h_company_session_status_changed_trigger.description: Runs each time a session status changes in H Company. Changes made before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, agent, agent_revision, status, agent_view_url, first_message.type, first_message.message, first_message.images, first_message.files, first_message.skills, first_message.caller_id, created_at, started_at, finished_at, last_activity_at, anonymized_at
